title: Home
author: William Saville
content:
Sometimes my heart aches,
For something unknown,
That feels and smells,
A little bit like home.
Where I am loved and accepted,
For all I am and strive to be,
Where everyone helps others,
Not just to make others see.
When kindness is not exhibited,
Just for publicity,
But for human connection,
In all its simplicity.
Where a kind smile or word,
Is as easy as breathing,
And no harsh words are uttered,
No anger is seething.
Where all people in our world,
Are seen as the same,
Seen as equals and family,
Even the poor and the lame.
If we all were kind,
And got to know who we hated,
I think our eyes would open,
And our hearts would be elated.
For hope and happiness,
Can blossom and grow,
If everyone listened,
To what the poor people know.
For those who have the least,
Have the most to give,
They fight the hardest,
To survive and live.
